disposition_reason: Fodder crop stress-physiology trial; shoot selenium shown only in a figure and as percent change.

study.design: lysimeter experiment on maize fodder under 100% and 60% field capacity with foliar sodium selenate (40 mg/L) versus water spray
study.method: ICP-OES for shoot selenium; physiological and fodder quality assays

non_numeric_findings: Lysimeter soil total selenium 0.074 mg/kg (Methods p. 2).
Foliar selenate at 40 mg/L under water deficit raised shoot selenium by 36% and fodder yield by 15% relative to control (Abstract).
